content.text: TVS Apache RTX 300 Review, India is seeing a surge in the popularity of adventure motorcycles and TVS has jumped on the bandwagon with the much-awaited Apache RTX 300. The RTX 300 is built for riders who want a mix of everyday utility and weekend adventure, and it offers modern styling, a new engine platform, premium features and long-distance comfort.
But is it worth the buy? Can it take on the likes of the KTM Adventure 250, Suzuki V-Strom SX, BMW G 310 GS and Royal Enfield Himalayan?

**Quick verdict:** The TVS Apache RTX 300 is shaping up to be one of the most compelling mid-capacity adventure bikes in India. It blends a new 300cc engine, touring-focused ergonomics, a feature-rich TFT package and expected aggressive pricing of ₹2.60–₹2.90 lakh. Buy it if you want a versatile ADV for daily rides and weekend touring; skip it if you mostly ride in dense city traffic or want a hardcore off-roader.
This in-depth review will go over everything you need to know – design, performance, mileage, comfort, features, pros, cons, and who shouldn’t buy this motorcycle.
TVS Apache RTX 300 at a Glance
The Apache RTR series has been developed with a different purpose but the RTX 300 has been developed as a purpose-built adventure motorcycle.
The stance is muscular and the instant premium ADV appeal is present.
The RTX 300 has TVS’s all new RT-XD4 engine.
This is not a high revving sports bike engine so the emphasis is more on usable torque for touring and mild off-roading.
The RTX 300 is an adventure bike but still easy to handle in city traffic.

content.text: The Apache RTX 300 has the potential to be one of the strongest adventure motorcycles in its segment. TVS has combined a new engine platform with modern technology and touring-focused ergonomics, making it an exciting option for riders looking to step into the ADV category.
If TVS can offer reliability, pricing and after-sales support, the RTX 300 could well be one of the best value-for-money adventure bikes in India.

The TVS Apache RTX 300 appears to be an interesting adventure motorcycle that can be used for daily commutes and also for weekend exploration. The comfortable ergonomics, feature-rich package and expected competitive pricing make it an attractive choice for riders looking for a versatile machine.

While it may not replace dedicated hardcore adventure motorcycles, it is capable enough with touring, occasional off-roading and daily commuting. If you’re a buyer after a modern mid-capacity ADV, the RTX 300 is certainly worth considering.
